original_training.source: A PARTING GIFT FOR YOU TO TAKE TO THE UNDERWORLD, COMMONER.
original_training.target: Un regalo de despedida para que te lleves al inframundo, plebeyo.
original_training.prepared_source: A parting gift for you to take to the underworld, commoner.

original_training.source: SHOW ME ONE OF YOUR... MAGIC ATTACKS.
original_training.target: Muéstrame uno de tus... ataques mágicos.
original_training.prepared_source: Show me one of your... Magic attacks.

original_training.source: THE THREE MOST IMPORTANT THINGS FOR A MAGICIAN... ARE PEDIGREE, TALENT, AND EFFORT.
original_training.target: Las tres cosas más importantes para un mago... son el linaje, el talento y el esfuerzo.
original_training.prepared_source: The three most important things for a magician... Are pedigree, talent, and effort.

original_training.source: WILLIAM BOLT, THE FATHER OF ALL MAGES, SAID THAT.
original_training.target: William Bolt, el padre de todos los magos, dijo eso.
original_training.prepared_source: William bolt, the father of all mages, said that.

original_training.source: DO NOT MISUNDERSTAND; "EFFORT" IS NOT THE ONLY PREREQUISITE. TO PUT IT ANOTHER WAY, NO MATTER HOW HARD ONE WORKS,
original_training.target: No lo malinterpretes; el esfuerzo no es el único requisito. Para decirlo de otra manera, no importa lo duro que uno trabaje.
original_training.prepared_source: Do not misunderstand; "effort" is not the only prerequisite. To put it another way, no matter how hard one works,

original_training.source: IF THEY WERE NOT BORN TO THE RIGHT PARENTS, OR WITH A GOOD AMOUNT OF TALENT; CURSED, LIKE YOU WERE...
original_training.target: Si no nacieron de los padres adecuados, o con una gran cantidad de talento; malditos, como tú...
original_training.prepared_source: If they were not born to the right parents, or with a good amount of talent; cursed, like you were...

original_training.source: THEN MAGIC WILL NEVER BE A SKILL OF YOURS.
original_training.target: Entonces la magia nunca será una habilidad tuya.
original_training.prepared_source: Then magic will never be a skill of yours.

original_training.source: TO STUDY EVEN MORE... TO MASTER...
original_training.target: Estudiar aún más para dominarla...
original_training.prepared_source: To study even more... To master...

original_training.source: SALOOM HAS A 7TH PRINCE!
original_training.target: ¡Saloom tiene un séptimo príncipe!
original_training.prepared_source: Saloom has a 7th prince!

original_training.source: UNDERSTOOD, WE'LL KEEP IT A SECRET.
original_training.target: Entendido, guardaremos el secreto.
original_training.prepared_source: Understood, we'll keep it a secret.

original_training.source: THOSE OF ROYAL BLOOD MUST AT LEAST TRY HUNTING...
original_training.target: Los de sangre real deben al menos intentar cazar...
original_training.prepared_source: Those of royal blood must at least try hunting...

original_training.source: DARN... HE GOT AWAY AGAIN.
original_training.target: Maldita sea... Escapó de nuevo.
original_training.prepared_source: Darn... He got away again.

original_training.source: THAT'S THE SEVENTH PRINCE, ISN'T IT? HE'S SO MUCH YOUNGER THAN HIS OTHER SIBLINGS THAT HE WON'T EVEN BE CONSIDERED AN HEIR... THERE'S NO POINT IN GIVING HIM SPECIAL TREATMENT.
original_training.target: Es el séptimo príncipe, ¿no es así? Es mucho más joven que sus otros hermanos que ni siquiera será considerado como heredero... No tiene sentido darle un trato especial.
original_training.prepared_source: That's the seventh prince, isn't it? He's so much younger than his other siblings that he won't even be considered an heir... There's no point in giving him special treatment.

original_training.source: DON'T BE STUPID.
original_training.target: No seas estúpido.
original_training.prepared_source: Don't be stupid.

original_training.source: HE UNDERSTOOD OUR LANGUAGE RIGHT OUT OF THE WOMB,
original_training.target: Entendió nuestro lenguaje al salir del vientre materno,
original_training.prepared_source: He understood our language right out of the womb,

original_training.source: THEN STARTED RIFLING THROUGH SPELLBOOKS INSTEAD OF PICTURE BOOKS!
original_training.target: ¡Luego empezó a hojear libros de hechizos en lugar de libros ilustrados!
original_training.prepared_source: Then started rifling through spellbooks instead of picture books!

original_training.source: AND MOST OF ALL...
original_training.target: Y sobre todo...
original_training.prepared_source: And most of all...

original_training.source: THE FATHER OF MAGIC? DON'T BE RIDICULOUS...
original_training.target: ¿El padre de la magia? No seas ridículo...
original_training.prepared_source: The father of magic? Don't be ridiculous...

original_training.source: OH, YOU'RE READING A NEWSPAPER? I THOUGHT THAT YOU HAD NO INTEREST IN THAT SORT OF THING.
original_training.target: Oh, ¿estás leyendo un periódico? Pensé que no te interesaban ese tipo de cosas.
original_training.prepared_source: Oh, you're reading a newspaper? I thought that you had no interest in that sort of thing.

original_training.source: I'M BORED. I ALREADY READ EVERY BOOK IN THE LIBRARY,
original_training.target: Estoy aburrido, ya que leí todos los libros de la biblioteca,
original_training.prepared_source: I'm bored. I already read every book in the library,

original_training.source: BUT THANKS TO THAT I LEARNED SOMETHING GOOD.
original_training.target: Pero gracias a eso aprendí algo bueno.
original_training.prepared_source: But thanks to that I learned something good.

original_training.source: I KNOW! LET'S GO TO A DUNGEON!
original_training.target: ¡Ya sé! ¡Vayamos a una mazmorra!
original_training.prepared_source: I know! Let's go to a dungeon!

original_training.source: I CAN MAKE UP FOR THAT WITH MAGIC AND TRICKS!
original_training.target: ¡Puedo compensarlo con trucos y magia!
original_training.prepared_source: I can make up for that with magic and tricks!

original_training.source: IT LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE YOU!
original_training.target: ¡Es exactamente como tú!
original_training.prepared_source: It looks exactly like you!

original_training.source: IT DOESN'T JUST LOOK THE SAME, I MADE THE BARK GROW ALL OVER IT AND TURN INTO BONES AND MEAT AND SKIN WHILE EMULATING BLOOD AND NERVOUS SYSTEMS! PLUS, IT EVEN MAKES SIMPLE MOVEMENTS AUTOMATICALLY!
original_training.target: ¡No solo se ve igual, hice que la corteza creciera por todos lados y se convirtiera en carne y huesos, también piel, al mismo tiempo que simula el flujo de la sangre y el sistema nervioso! ¡Además, incluso puede realizar movimientos sencillos por su cuenta!
original_training.target_faithfulness_correction: Plus is rendered as Además rather than the reference's causal Así que.
original_training.prepared_source: It doesn't just look the same, I made the bark grow all over it and turn into bones and meat and skin while emulating blood and nervous systems! Plus, it even makes simple movements automatically!

original_training.source: YEAH, PREVIOUSLY
original_training.target: Sí, anteriormente...
original_training.prepared_source: Yeah, previously

original_training.source: NO... IF IT WAS SO EASY I WOULD HAVE DONE IT LONG AGO. THE MAIN PROBLEM IS SILPHA.
original_training.target: No... Si fuera tan fácil lo hubiera hecho desde hace tiempo. El problema principal es Silpha.
original_training.target_faithfulness_correction: Added principal to preserve the printed source MAIN.
original_training.prepared_source: No... If it was so easy I would have done it long ago. The main problem is silpha.

original_training.source: YES. ABOUT 0.7 MILIMETRES...
original_training.target: Sí, como unos 0.7 milímetros...
original_training.prepared_source: Yes. About 0.7 Milimetres...

original_training.source: LLOYD-SAMA. YOU HAVE GROWN AGAIN.
original_training.target: Lloyd-sama, has crecido de nuevo.
original_training.target_faithfulness_correction: Added de nuevo to preserve the printed source AGAIN.
original_training.prepared_source: Lloyd-sama. You have grown again.

original_training.source: YEAH. I DON'T THINK I CAN FOOL HER WITH THIS SIMPLE DANCE ROUTINE.
original_training.target: Sí, no creo poder engañarla con algo como un simple baile.
original_training.prepared_source: Yeah. I don't think I can fool her with this simple dance routine.

original_training.source: OKAY! MY GREAT ESCAPE WAS A SUCCESS!
original_training.target: ¡Bien! ¡Mi gran escape ha sido un éxito!
original_training.target_faithfulness_correction: Added gran to preserve the printed source GREAT.
original_training.prepared_source: Okay! My great escape was a success!

original_training.source: YES! I CAN HEAR YOU!
original_training.target: ¡Sí! ¡Te escucho!
original_training.prepared_source: Yes! I can hear you!

original_training.source: I THINK... I'VE SUCCESSFULLY BECOME YOUR BODY DOUBLE.
original_training.target: Creo... que ha sido un éxito el volverme tu doble.
original_training.prepared_source: I think... I've successfully become your body double.

original_training.source: LLOYD-SAMA IS CARING ABOUT HIS APPEARANCE!
original_training.target: ¡Lloyd-sama se preocupa por su apariencia!
original_training.prepared_source: Lloyd-sama is caring about his appearance!

original_training.source: WOO! BE WARY OF SILPHA AND CONTINUE PLAYING THE PART OF LLOYD!
original_training.target: ¡Oh! ¡Ten cuidado con Silpha y sigue haciendo tu papel como Lloyd!
original_training.prepared_source: Woo! Be wary of silpha and continue playing the part of lloyd!

original_training.source: OOH! WHAT IS THIS? THE TRUE BOSS?
original_training.target: ¡Oh! ¿Qué es esto? ¿El verdadero jefe?
original_training.annotation_note: Normalized the target deictic to preserve printed THIS.
original_training.prepared_source: Ooh! What is this? The true boss?

original_training.source: THIS IS A BAD JOKE-ARU!
original_training.target: ¡Esto es una broma de mal gusto-aru!
original_training.prepared_source: This is a bad joke-aru!

original_training.source: WHY IS THERE SUCH A POWERFUL MONSTER IN A LOW LEVEL DUNGEON?
original_training.target: ¿Por qué hay un monstruo tan poderoso en una mazmorra de bajo nivel?
original_training.prepared_source: Why is there such a powerful monster in a low level dungeon?

original_training.source: EVEN AN A CLASS ADVENTURER COULD BARELY DEFEAT THIS THING!
original_training.target: ¡Incluso un aventurero de clase A apenas podría derrotar a esta cosa!
original_training.annotation_note: Added apenas to preserve BARELY omitted in the published reference.
original_training.prepared_source: Even an a class adventurer could barely defeat this thing!

original_training.source: I HAVE TO STALL-ARU! AT LEAST UNTIL ROBERTO MAKES IT OUTSIDE!
original_training.target: ¡Tengo que detenerlo-aru! ¡Al menos hasta que Roberto salga!
original_training.prepared_source: I have to stall-aru! At least until roberto makes it outside!

original_training.source: I STILL WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT THE KI FIGHTING STYLE - AND THE DUNGEON TOO.
original_training.target: Todavía quiero saber más sobre el estilo de pelea Ki y también de la mazmorra.
original_training.prepared_source: I still want to know more about the ki fighting style - and the dungeon too.

original_training.source: SO THAT JUST HAPPENED.
original_training.target: Así que eso acaba de suceder.
original_training.annotation_note: Corrected an ungrammatical reference to the declarative meaning printed in English.
original_training.prepared_source: So that just happened.

original_training.source: I HAVE NO IDEA WHY I WAS SENT FLYING. IS THERE ANY REASON I CAN'T JUST STROLL BACK IN?
original_training.target: No tengo ni idea de por qué me enviaron volando. ¿Hay alguna razón por la que no pueda simplemente volver a entrar tranquilamente?
original_training.annotation_note: Preserved the casual movement modifier in JUST STROLL rather than only returning/entering.
original_training.prepared_source: I have no idea why I was sent flying. Is there any reason I can't just stroll back in?

original_training.source: WHAT DO YOU THINK, GRIM?
original_training.target: ¿Qué te parece, Grim?
original_training.annotation_note: Only the corresponding Spanish balloon is used; a neighboring short utterance is not merged.
original_training.prepared_source: What do you think, grim?

original_training.source: ROBERTO SHOULD BE SAFE BY NOW. I GOTTA GET OUT OF HERE TOO... Y'KNOW...
original_training.target: Roberto ya debería estar a salvo. Yo también tengo que salir de aquí... Ya sabes...
original_training.prepared_source: Roberto should be safe by now. I gotta get out of here too... Y'know...

original_training.source: IF MY MEMORY SERVES, IT WAS A TECHNIQUE FROM ANOTHER COUNTRY. THERE WAS ONE AMONGST THOSE I DEVOURED ONCE...
original_training.target: Si mi memoria no falla, era una técnica de otro país. Había uno entre los que devoré una vez...
original_training.prepared_source: If my memory serves, it was a technique from another country. There was one amongst those I devoured once...

original_training.source: WELL, IN THE END IT'S JUST AN INFERIOR SUBSTITUTE FOR MAGIC.
original_training.target: Bien, al final es solo un sustituto inferior de la magia.
original_training.prepared_source: Well, in the end it's just an inferior substitute for magic.

original_training.source: COMPARED TO THE SOULS... OF THE ADVENTURERS I'VE DEVOURED UNTIL NOW...
original_training.target: Comparado con las almas... de los aventureros que he devorado hasta ahora...
original_training.prepared_source: Compared to the souls... Of the adventurers I've devoured until now...

original_training.source: YOU ARE NOT WORTH EATING.
original_training.target: No vale la pena comerte.
original_training.prepared_source: You are not worth eating.

original_training.source: AND THE KNOWLEDGE... I'VE GAINED...
original_training.target: Y el conocimiento... que he adquirido...
original_training.annotation_note: Used the natural Spanish synonym adquirido for gained knowledge.
original_training.prepared_source: And the knowledge... I've gained...

original_training.source: THAT MAN WAS FAR MORE...
original_training.target: Ese hombre era mucho más...
original_training.prepared_source: That man was far more...

original_training.source: YOU AND ROBERTO ARE COMPLETELY DIFFERENT, YOU KNOW-ARU?
original_training.target: Tú y Roberto son completamente diferentes, ¿lo sabes-aru?
original_training.prepared_source: You and roberto are completely different, you know-aru?

original_training.source: EVEN THOUGH YOU ARE BOTH TRYING TO LEARN EVERYTHING YOU CAN,
original_training.target: Aunque ambos están intentando aprender todo lo que pueden,
original_training.prepared_source: Even though you are both trying to learn everything you can,

original_training.source: ROBERTO IS SOMEONE WHO CAN EVEN FIND MEANING IN A SINGLE PEBBLE!
original_training.target: ¡Roberto es alguien que puede encontrar significado incluso en un solo guijarro!
original_training.annotation_note: Preserved EVEN and SINGLE explicitly in the annotation.
original_training.prepared_source: Roberto is someone who can even find meaning in a single pebble!

original_training.source: I WAS PRETTY HAPPY, Y'KNOW? THE KI TECHNIQUE IS ALWAYS CALLED A MARTIAL ART FOR YOKELS. BUT ROBERTO SAID IT WAS AMAZING-NE.
original_training.target: Estaba bastante contenta, ¿sabes? La técnica del Ki siempre se llama un arte marcial para palurdos. Pero Roberto dijo que era increíble-ne.
original_training.annotation_note: Preserved degree PRETTY and the generic present IS CALLED rather than the reference's past tense.
original_training.prepared_source: I was pretty happy, y'know? The ki technique is always called a martial art for yokels. But roberto said it was amazing-ne.

original_training.source: WHY SHOULD I CARE?
original_training.target: ¿Por qué debería importarme?
original_training.prepared_source: Why should I care?

original_training.source: DON'T BOTHER.
original_training.target: No te molestes.
original_training.prepared_source: Don't bother.

original_training.source: A BARRIER?! LIKE I GIVE A SHIT!
original_training.target: ¿Una barrera?! ¡Me importa un carajo!
original_training.prepared_source: A barrier?! Like I give a shit!

original_training.source: EVERY SINGLE DAY SINCE I WAS FIVE YEARS OLD-NE! COME RAIN OR SNOW, WITHOUT EVER GETTING A BOYFRIEND.
original_training.target: Todos y cada uno de los días desde que tenía cinco años-ne, llueva o nieve, sin haber conseguido nunca un novio.
original_training.annotation_note: Preserved EVERY SINGLE DAY and WITHOUT EVER; omitted the reference's added insult not present in this English balloon.
original_training.prepared_source: Every single day since I was five years old-ne! Come rain or snow, without ever getting a boyfriend.

original_training.source: KEEP YOUR DISTANCE AND WAIT FOR AN OPENING!
original_training.target: ¡Mantenga la distancia y espere una apertura!
original_training.prepared_source: Keep your distance and wait for an opening!

original_training.source: DESPITE THEIR SIZE, BEAR WOLVES ARE QUITE FAST! DON'T YOU THINK SO, GRIM...?!
original_training.target: ¡A pesar de su tamaño, los lobos oso son bastante rápidos! ¿No crees, Grim...?
original_training.annotation_note: Preserved the BEAR component of the monster class omitted in this reference balloon.
original_training.prepared_source: Despite their size, bear wolves are quite fast! Don't you think so, grim...?!

original_training.source: LLOYD-SAMA, GET BEHIND ME.
original_training.target: Lloyd-sama, ponte detrás de mí.
original_training.prepared_source: Lloyd-sama, get behind me.

original_training.source: THAT BROKEN SHRINE... COULD IT BE?
original_training.target: Ese santuario destruido... ¿Podría ser?
original_training.prepared_source: That broken shrine... Could it be?

original_training.source: HOORAY! JUST AS EXPECTED FROM OUR PRINCE ALBERTO!
original_training.target: ¡Hurra! Tal como se esperaba de nuestro príncipe Alberto.
original_training.prepared_source: Hooray! Just as expected from our prince alberto!

original_training.source: IT'S ONLY LIKE THIS DUE TO THE ENCHANTMENTS LLOYD PUT ON MY SWORD.
original_training.target: Solo es así debido a los encantamientos que Lloyd puso en mi espada.
original_training.prepared_source: It's only like this due to the enchantments lloyd put on my sword.

original_training.source: WHAT A POWERFUL SPELL! IT KILLED IT IN ONE SHOT!
original_training.target: ¡Qué poderoso hechizo! ¡Lo mató de un solo disparo!
original_training.prepared_source: What a powerful spell! It killed it in one shot!

original_training.source: NO... NORMALLY, THE SPELL ISN'T THIS POWERFUL...
original_training.target: No... Normalmente, el hechizo no es tan poderoso...
original_training.prepared_source: No... Normally, the spell isn't this powerful...

original_training.source: THE ENCHANTMENT ON ALBERTO NII-SAMA'S MAGIC SWORD WAS ALSO A SUCCESS! WHEW, SINCE THAT SWORD LOOKED EXPENSIVE, I WAS REALLY NERVOUS WHILE ENCHANTING IT!
original_training.target: ¡El encantamiento en la espada mágica de Alberto Nii-sama también fue un éxito! Uf, como esa espada parecía cara, estaba realmente nervioso mientras la encantaba.
original_training.annotation_note: Rendered the interjection naturally as Uf; all factual clauses and qualifiers remain.
original_training.prepared_source: The enchantment on alberto nii-sama's magic sword was also a success! Whew, since that sword looked expensive, I was really nervous while enchanting it!

original_training.source: MORE IMPORTANTLY, LLOYD-SAMA, I JUST REMEMBERED...
original_training.target: Más importante, Lloyd-sama, acabo de recordar...
original_training.prepared_source: More importantly, lloyd-sama, I just remembered...

original_training.source: THAT SHRINE WAS USED TO SEAL A MAJIN.
original_training.target: Ese santuario fue usado para sellar un Majin.
original_training.prepared_source: That shrine was used to seal a majin.

original_training.source: KUFUFUFU. YOU PATHETIC HUMANS!
original_training.target: Kufufufu. ¡Patéticos humanos!
original_training.prepared_source: Kufufufu. You pathetic humans!

original_training.source: HOW DARE YOU HURT MY UNDERLINGS!
original_training.target: ¡Cómo se atreven a herir a mis subordinados!
original_training.prepared_source: How dare you hurt my underlings!

original_training.source: UGH! THERE'S A MAJIN... IN ITS MOUTH!?
original_training.target: ¡Ugh! Hay un Majin... ¡¿En su boca?!
original_training.prepared_source: Ugh! There's a majin... In its mouth!?

original_training.source: YEAH... THESE ARE CLEARLY DIFFERENT FROM ANY BEAR WOLVES THAT I KNOW OF. THERE EVEN SEEMS TO BE SOME HYBRID ONES MIXED IN THERE AS WELL...
original_training.target: Sí, estos son claramente diferentes a cualquier lobo oso que yo conozca. Incluso parece que hay híbridos mezclados allí también...
original_training.prepared_source: Yeah... These are clearly different from any bear wolves that I know of. There even seems to be some hybrid ones mixed in there as well...

original_training.source: THIS SUCKS-ARU! THEY REGENERATE IMMEDIATELY-ARU!
original_training.target: ¡Esto apesta-aru! ¡Se regeneran inmediatamente-aru!
original_training.annotation_note: Preserved the printed English speech suffix in both clauses.
original_training.prepared_source: This sucks-aru! They regenerate immediately-aru!

original_training.source: THEY'RE PROBABLY... BEING CONTROLLED... BY THE POWER OF THAT MAJIN!
original_training.target: Probablemente están... siendo controlados... ¡Por el poder de ese Majin!
original_training.prepared_source: They're probably... Being controlled... By the power of that majin!

original_training.source: THAT PAZUZU MUST'VE BEEN THE MAJIN WHO BROKE THE SEAL IN THAT SHRINE AND GOT OUT!
original_training.target: ¡Ese Pazuzu debe haber sido el Majin que rompió el sello en ese santuario y salió!
original_training.prepared_source: That pazuzu must've been the majin who broke the seal in that shrine and got out!

original_training.source: SO YOU'RE BOTH MAJIN, RIGHT? YOU KNOW HIM?
original_training.target: Así que ambos son Majin, ¿verdad? ¿Lo conoces?
original_training.prepared_source: So you're both majin, right? You know him?

original_training.source: IN ORDER TO MAKE THE MAGICAL BEASTS THINK OF HIM AS THEIR PARENT, HE CHANGES THE NATURE OF HIS MAGIC BY ALTERING THE SMELL OR COLOUR OF HIS MAGIC IN ACCORDANCE TO THE BEASTS' TASTES.
original_training.target: Para hacer que las bestias mágicas piensen en él como su padre, cambia la naturaleza de su magia alterando el olor o el color de su magia de acuerdo con los gustos de las bestias.
original_training.prepared_source: In order to make the magical beasts think of him as their parent, he changes the nature of his magic by altering the smell or colour of his magic in accordance to the beasts' tastes.

original_training.source: BUT THAT PAZUZU GUY... HE MUST BE USING [MAGICAL NATURE CHANGE] TO CONTROL THOSE MAGIC BEASTS.
original_training.target: Pero ese tal Pazuzu... debe estar usando [cambio de naturaleza mágica] para controlar a esas bestias mágicas.
original_training.prepared_source: But that pazuzu guy... He must be using [magical nature change] to control those magic beasts.

original_training.source: THE MAGIC HE POURS IN ALSO INCREASES THEIR REGENERATION ABILITY. I RECKON IT'S SOMETHING LIKE A PUPPETEER'S STRINGS WHICH ALSO ACTS AS A PIPE FOR RECHARGING MAGIC.
original_training.target: La magia que vierte también aumenta su capacidad de regeneración. Creo que es algo así como los hilos de un titiritero, que también sirven de conducto para recargar magia.
original_training.annotation_note: Normalized Spanish agreement and the conduit metaphor without dropping the regeneration or recharge clauses.
original_training.prepared_source: The magic he pours in also increases their regeneration ability. I reckon it's something like a puppeteer's strings which also acts as a pipe for recharging magic.

original_training.source: IF WE DON'T DEFEAT PAZUZU, THIS MIGHT NEVER END...
original_training.target: Si no derrotamos a Pazuzu, esto podría no terminar nunca...
original_training.prepared_source: If we don't defeat pazuzu, this might never end...

original_training.source: TEACH ME HOW TO USE [MAGICAL NATURE CHANGE]!
original_training.target: ¡¡Enséñame a usar [cambio de naturaleza mágica]!!
original_training.prepared_source: Teach me how to use [magical nature change]!

original_training.source: WOULDN'T NOW BE A BAD IDEA THOUGH... LOOK, EVERYONE'S FIGHTING FOR THEIR LIVES AND SUCH...
original_training.target: Pero ¿no sería ahora una mala idea...? Mira, todo el mundo está luchando por su vida y tal...
original_training.annotation_note: Corrected the reference's misleading polarity: the English is a negative question proposing that NOW is a bad time.
original_training.prepared_source: Wouldn't now be a bad idea though... Look, everyone's fighting for their lives and such...

original_training.source: IT'S FINE! C'MON, HURRY UP!
original_training.target: ¡Está bien! ¡Vamos, apúrate!
original_training.annotation_note: Emphatic vowel lengthening in FIIINE is normalized for word-level MT; no claim of exact character-level transcription.
original_training.prepared_source: It's fine! C'mon, hurry up!

original_training.source: GUHUHU! FRAGILE! SO FRAGILE!
original_training.target: ¡Guhuhu! ¡Frágil! ¡Tan frágil!
original_training.prepared_source: Guhuhu! Fragile! So fragile!

packed_training.source: A PARTING GIFT FOR YOU TO TAKE TO THE UNDERWORLD, COMMONER. WILLIAM BOLT, THE FATHER OF ALL MAGES, SAID THAT.
packed_training.target: Un regalo de despedida para que te lleves al inframundo, plebeyo. William Bolt, el padre de todos los magos, dijo eso.
packed_training.prepared_source: A parting gift for you to take to the underworld, commoner. William bolt, the father of all mages, said that.

packed_training.source: A PARTING GIFT FOR YOU TO TAKE TO THE UNDERWORLD, COMMONER. SALOOM HAS A 7TH PRINCE! THEN STARTED RIFLING THROUGH SPELLBOOKS INSTEAD OF PICTURE BOOKS!
packed_training.target: Un regalo de despedida para que te lleves al inframundo, plebeyo. ¡Saloom tiene un séptimo príncipe! ¡Luego empezó a hojear libros de hechizos en lugar de libros ilustrados!
packed_training.prepared_source: A parting gift for you to take to the underworld, commoner. Saloom has a 7th prince! Then started rifling through spellbooks instead of picture books!

packed_training.source: SHOW ME ONE OF YOUR... MAGIC ATTACKS. THEN MAGIC WILL NEVER BE A SKILL OF YOURS.
packed_training.target: Muéstrame uno de tus... ataques mágicos. Entonces la magia nunca será una habilidad tuya.
